$comment: Every master file in the R2 archive bucket, with the byte count and SHA-256 measured on the local copy before upload: the production-ready FIXED GLBs (five from 2026-08/09-01 plus three added 2026-09-02 under fixed-glbs/2026-09-02/) and the ten raw CLO exports. CLO project files (.zprj) are deliberately NOT here — owner decision 2026-09-02, they stay on local storage. scripts/verify-archive.mjs compares the bucket against this list nightly; add a row whenever a file is added to the bucket. Written 2026-09-02 for audit findings CI-02 / CI-08. Rows under fixed-glbs/2026-09-03-diffuse-off/ (2026-09-03 evening): the FIXED GLBs folder re-exported with "Diffuse Color Combined on Texture" OFF, which is the export that carries a colour per colourway (audits F1-04, F2-02, F2-03, FX-01); the earlier copies stay in the bucket as superseded until the owner deletes them.

aliases.note: raw/cycling-all-colours.glb in the repo checkout is byte-identical (cmp) to 3D Products/cycling all colours.glb, so only the latter is stored.
